post.description: Conflict rule (v1.12, extended in v1.13): the ONLY blocking clash is the lead rule: the meeting's organizer OR its internal chair is, at an overlapping time, the organizer or the internal chair of another SCHEDULED meeting → 409 and nothing is saved (checked on create and on every edit that changes the time or the chair; priority plays no role; the message names the role: TIME_CONFLICT_BLOCKING for the organizer, TIME_CONFLICT_CHAIR_BLOCKING for the chair). Every other overlap that shares an officer (members, a lead who is only a member elsewhere) is a warning, whatever the priorities: the meeting is saved, a PENDING concurrent-meeting record is kept per shared officer, and the shared officers plus the lower-priority organizer (both organizers on equal priority) are informed. Guest officers are never checked. Touching times (11:00–12:00 after 10:00–11:00) do not clash.

info.title: BBS Meeting Schedule API
info.description: Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) and SID — meeting schedule system. Errors: `{ statusCode, message, error, code, requestId }` (409 organizer-rule clashes add `blocking`; validation errors add `codes`, one per message). Language (v1.6): send `Accept-Language: en` or `bn` (or `X-Lang`, which wins; the web app sends both); error and success messages come back in that language (Bangla when the header is missing). `code` never changes with the language. PDF reports, emails and notifications are always Bangla.
